# paylink.lol

> paylink.lol is a real-time attention leaderboard and decentralized-style link discovery directory where creators, startups, developers, and projects share their links and compete for top visibility through transparent live bidding. "You pay, you rank."

## Core Philosophy & Summary

paylink.lol operates on a simple, transparent principle:
1. **Free Link Sharing**: Anyone can submit and list their project or website for free with Cloudflare Turnstile bot verification.
2. **Transparent Live Bidding**: Want #1 visibility? Anyone can place a bid or boost an existing link with an outbid to climb the leaderboard instantly.
3. **No Recurring Subscriptions**: All rankings are pay-as-you-go. When you pay, you rank immediately. Your rank remains until another project outbids you.
4. **Real-time Live Feed**: Every new submission, outbid battle, and visitor click is broadcast live via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
5. **Verified & Moderated**: Built-in automated URL safety heuristics, spam/phishing filters, domain deduplication, and admin moderation protect the leaderboard integrity.

---

- [Homepage & Live Leaderboard](https://paylink.lol/): View active links ranked by bid amount, explore categories, submit links, and place outbids.

- [Privacy Policy](https://paylink.lol/privacy): Transparent privacy policy, zero-tracking policy, and data handling practices.
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://paylink.lol/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive documentation including API schemas, data models, and system architecture for LLMs.

---

## Category Taxonomy

Projects on paylink.lol are organized into curated categories:
- **AI & Automation**: AI tools, agents, LLMs, workflow automation, and machine learning software.
- **SaaS & Software**: B2B and B2C software products, micro-SaaS, and developer tools.
- **Design & Creative**: UI/UX tools, portfolios, graphics, fonts, and creative assets.
- **Developer Tools**: APIs, SDKs, open source repositories, frameworks, and dev platforms.
- **Crypto & Web3**: Blockchain applications, DeFi protocols, tokens, and Web3 tools.
- **Media & Content**: Newsletters, blogs, podcasts, YouTube channels, and digital media.
- **Finance & Money**: Fintech apps, investment platforms, and billing services.
- **Other**: Diverse innovations, communities, and indie projects.

---

## Public REST & Streaming API for AI Agents & Bots

All endpoints support `GET` and return JSON (or SSE streams for live data). Base URL: `https://paylink.lol`

### 1. Active Ranked Listings
- **URL**: `GET /api/listings`
- **Description**: Returns all currently active listings ordered by rank (`#1` has highest `bid_amount`).
- **Response Format**: JSON Array of Listing objects:
  - `id` (string): Unique identifier (e.g. `lst_abc123`)
  - `rank` (number): 1-based leaderboard position
  - `title` (string): Project name / title
  - `url` (string): Destination website URL
  - `description` (string): Short pitch / tagline
  - `category` (string): Category tag
  - `bid_amount` (number): Current cumulative bid amount in USD
  - `clicks` (number): Total verified clicks received
  - `created_at` (string): ISO 8601 timestamp

### 2. Single Listing Lookup
- **URL**: `GET /api/listings/:id`
- **Description**: Retrieve detailed information for a specific listing ID.

### 3. Platform Live Stats
- **URL**: `GET /api/stats`
- **Description**: Returns high-level platform metrics:
  - `total_listings` (number): Count of active listings
  - `highest_bid` (number): Current #1 bid amount in USD
  - `total_bids` (number): Total USD volume processed
  - `active_visitors` (number): Real-time online visitors

### 4. Recent Outbid & Battle Activity
- **URL**: `GET /api/activity`
- **Description**: Returns recent outbid events, rank flips, and listing creation events.

### 5. Real-Time SSE Stream
- **URL**: `GET /api/live-feed`
- **Content-Type**: `text/event-stream`
- **Events**:
  - `connected`: Initial snapshot of listings, stats, and recent outbids
  - `leaderboard_update`: Fired on every new listing or outbid with updated rankings
  - `visitors_update`: Fired when active visitor count changes
  - `click_update`: Fired when a listing receives a click redirect

---

## Rules & Safety Standards

- **Prohibited Content**: Phishing, malware, scams, hate speech, illegal products, deceptive redirects, and malicious links are strictly banned. Violating listings are removed immediately without refund.
- **Domain Deduplication**: Each unique domain (e.g., `example.com`) can only have one active listing at a time to prevent feed flooding. Existing listings for the same domain must be outbid/boosted.
- **Payment Verification**: Stripe Checkout with cryptographic webhook validation ensures only genuine, settled transactions update the live rankings.
